title: Get the project's default access
description: The access everyone in the project gets unless a member or role rule says otherwise: the default project level (none, member or admin) and the default level per tool (none, viewer, editor or manager), with the lowest and highest level each tool allows. A project level of `none` blocks access to the project and its resources. Also lists which tools accept rules on single objects, such as one dashboard or one notebook. Start here to understand a project's baseline before checking a member or role.

methodDocumentation.text: The project's default access. Returns the level that applies to the project and to each resource type when a member or a role has no rule of their own. Also lists the resource types that accept rules on single objects, with the levels such a rule can set.
